name: yf_etf_info
description:
Key fund facts for one ETF or mutual fund from Yahoo Finance (a subset of yfinance Ticker.info).
Returns: {symbol, etf_info} with whichever of shortName, longName, category, fundFamily, totalAssets, yield, ytdReturn, threeYearAverageReturn, fiveYearAverageReturn, expenseRatio Yahoo provides (returns and yield as fractions).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (fund ticker, e.g. SPY, QQQ, VTI).
Holdings and sector weights: openbb_etf_holdings, openbb_etf_sectors; full info dictionary: yf_stock_info. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "SPY"}
